projects.title: Smart Times
projects.description:
He sees you, he knows you.
He passes through walls.
Processing your data,
he answers your calls.

He listens and records,
he knows where you are.
Without him, my friend,
you won’t get very far.

He made you addicted —
life is pink like gum —
that sticks to your pants...
yes, it all was a scam.

He’s smart, you are not.
You can’t think on your own.
Oh no...
you’re a victim
of your cellular phone.

projects.title: Wings
projects.description:
One of humanity’s greatest desires 
 has always been the urge to fly. 
 All it takes is a pair of wings, right? 
 (And an enormous engine, in our case...) 

 Birds: 
 — dwellers of treetops 
 — inhabitants of lakes 
 — tireless recyclers of the city’s leftovers. 
 Fasten your seatbelts; 
 the captain wishes you a pleasant flight.
